jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer
jobs.description:
### **At Fiskars Group we are unified and driven by our common purpose: pioneering design to make the everyday extraordinary. Join our team and seize the extraordinary opportunity to influence the everyday!**

**Fiskars Group**

**Senior Design Engineer – R&D**

**OUR ROLE**

We are seeking a talented **Senior Design Engineer** to join Fiskars R&D team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of creating cutting-edge designs that elevate our product offerings and meet the evolving needs of our consumers. You will collaborate with a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of design and technology.

Fiskars Group values creativity and independence, providing an environment where non-standardized work and complex challenges are the norm. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, including industrial designers, product managers, and marketing experts, and liaise with our global factories and suppliers.

If you are passionate about engineering, thrive in solving intricate problems, and seek to contribute to a heritage-rich company committed to design and functionality in lifestyle products, Fiskars Group is the place for you.

This position is based either in Espoo or Billnäs factory, Finland and reports to our Senior Manager, R&D. The role is full-time and is hybrid.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO AT FISKARS GROUP**

**Responsibilities:**

* With limited supervision, using conceptual design and 3D CAD modelling, design products that meet the objective of the project proposal and can be implemented within performance and cost constraints. Perform design validation testing of prototypes and off-tool samples and define design modifications to guarantee compliance with technical specifications and performance requirements.
* Develop documentation that defines the performance requirements for the product and product acceptance criteria to ensure an acceptable level of quality in the product.
* Concept and Prototype. Get hands on in the lab building, testing, modifying, validating ideas and thoughts for current and possible future projects
* Participate in marketing research activities. Translate observations from field research, ethnography and focus groups into concept sketches and drawings. Analyse competing & related products and technologies.
* Support supply chain in identifying cost reduction opportunities and making design refinements as required.
* Support business & offering and sales with proof-of-concept prototypes and production quality prototypes for customer sales presentations.

**WHO YOU ARE**

**Experience:**

  

* MSc/BSc degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
* 5+ years of experience in product development, with a strong focus on mechanical design.
* Proficiency in 3D CAD/solid modelling software (SolidWorks preferred) and Microsoft Office Suite, with a solid understanding of plastic and metal part manufacturing technologies.
* Ability to effectively communicate design proposals through 2D/3D visualizations and prototypes.
* Strong ideation and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail and a passion for innovation.
* Positive attitude and ability to give and receive constructive feedback.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions.

**START YOUR JOURNEY AT FISKARS GROUP**

We are eagerly awaiting your application. We review applications on a continuous basis, so please submit your CV in English today!

For further information please contact: Tao Huang, Senior Manager, R&D at tao.huang@fiskars.com.

We are committed to protecting your personal data, so we only accept applications through our career website. Join us and be part of our journey to create value through strong brands, innovative products, and unique design.

Apply now and make your mark with Fiskars Group!

**#LI-VC1**

**Last day of application:**

2026-10-24

\*\*\*\*\*

At Fiskars, we value providing benefits that matter to you and cater to our diverse global workforce, no matter where you are in the world. While benefits may vary based on location, here are some of the incredible offerings you can expect when joining our team:

**Competitive Compensation:** We ensure that our employees are fairly compensated based on industry standards and local market factors.

**Health and Wellness:** Your well-being matters to us, no matter where you are. We offer various health and well-being focused programs and coverage, adapted to the requirements of each region.

**Work-Life Balance:** We understand the need for balance in your life. Our paid time off plans and flexible work arrangements and policies are designed to accommodate local customs and personal commitments, enabling you to thrive in both your professional and personal life.

**Professional Development:** We believe in nurturing talent and supporting professional growth. Through training programs, skill development initiatives and learning resources, we empower our employees to reach their full potential.

**Inclusive and Diverse Environment:** We value diversity and promote inclusivity. Join a workplace where your unique background and perspectives are celebrated, fostering collaboration and respect across all our markets.

**Recognition and Rewards:** We believe in celebrating and recognizing the contributions of our employees worldwide. Our recognition programs are designed to acknowledge exceptional performance and achievements, ensuring that your efforts are celebrated and valued.

**Employee Discounts:** We want to ensure our team members make each day the extraordinary with use of our products and offer product discounts across our brands.

*Please note that specific benefits may vary based on local regulations, market conditions, and other factors. We are committed to providing competitive and meaningful benefits to our employees in every market we operate.*

\*\*\*\*\*

***Pioneering design to make the everyday extraordinary***

*Fiskars Group (FSKRS, Nasdaq Helsinki) is the global home of design-driven brands for indoor and outdoor living. Since 1649, we have designed products of timeless, purposeful, and functional beauty, while driving innovation and sustainable growth. In 2025, Fiskars Group’s global net sales were EUR 1.1 billion, and we had approximately 6,600 employees. We have two Business Areas (BA), Vita and Fiskars.*

*BA Vita offers products in the high-end homeware segment as well as fine branded jewelry. Its desirable brands include Georg Jensen, Royal Copenhagen, Wedgwood, Moomin Arabia, Iittala and Waterford. In 2025, BA Vita’s reported net sales were EUR 613 million, and it had approximately 5,000 employees.*

*BA Fiskars offers functional innovations in the gardening and outdoor categories, in addition to the scissors and creating, as well as cooking categories. The brands include Fiskars and Gerber. In 2025, BA Fiskars’ net sales were EUR 522 million, and it had approximately 1,300 employees.*

### ***Read more:*** ***fiskarsgroup.com***

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Are you passionate about building software that powers real-world manufacturing and drives the digital transformation of global production?** Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives.

As our new **Full-Stack Software Developer**, you'll be designing, developing, and maintaining full-stack applications for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) that support critical production processes across Grundfos's global manufacturing sites. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.

**What you will be doing**
==========================

As a key part of the Manufacturing IT team, you'll create impact by building scalable, integrated software solutions that connect enterprise systems with shop-floor operations, enabling smarter and more efficient production worldwide.

Your main responsibilities include:

* Design, develop, and deploy full-stack applications using .NET, C#, React, and MS SQL on local servers or Azure Cloud services
* Build APIs and backend services for system integration, including SAP and shop-floor automation equipment using industrial protocols such as OPC UA
* Collaborate with production engineering, IT, and infrastructure stakeholders to translate business needs into reliable, maintainable software solutions
* Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines and automation scripts for build, test, and deployment workflows
* Ensure code quality through peer reviews, unit/integration testing, and adherence to coding standards within an agile SCRUM team
* Provide mentorship and technical guidance to associate developers while contributing to architectural discussions and continuous improvement

**What makes you a great fit**
==============================

Above all, you're a skilled full-stack developer with strong .NET and React experience, a solid grasp of system integration patterns, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical peers and domain experts in a fast-paced agile environment.

We'd also imagine that you are/have:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* 3+ years of full-stack development experience with .NET, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and MS SQL
* Solid understanding of software engineering principles and patterns (e.g., SOLID), RESTful APIs, and web application frameworks
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting (e.g., PowerShell)

It's a plus if you also:

* Experience with Siemens Opcenter Discrete MES platform development and configuration
* Familiarity with ERP systems (especially SAP) and/or shop-floor integration using industrial protocols (OPC UA, MQTT)
* Experience with Azure Cloud services and containerized deployments

**Why you'll love working here**
================================

Day to day, you can look forward to:

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
* Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.
* Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering.
* On-demand training and structured development programmes to support your growth.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.

**Join Grundfos, apply today!**

jobs.title: Software Engineer til Advertisement & Partner Management i TV 2 Teknologi
jobs.description:
### **Vil du bygge løsninger, som har direkte betydning for TV 2s forretning?**

I Advertisement & Partner Management udvikler vi de systemer, der gør det muligt at planlægge, booke og håndtere reklamer på TV 2s platforme. Det er et område med stor betydning for forretningen, høj kompleksitet og gode muligheder for at skabe mærkbare resultater.

Vi søger en software engineer med nogle års erfaring, som kan bygge gode løsninger og trives i et team, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og godt arbejdsmiljø går hånd i hånd.

Du bliver en del af et område i udvikling. Vi moderniserer vores løsninger, bygger nye cloud-baserede services og udforsker, hvordan AI og agentiske workflows kan blive en naturlig del af softwareudviklingen. Derfor leder vi efter en kollega, der er nysgerrig på teknologi og har lyst til at bidrage til fællesskabet.

### **Rollen**

Som Software Engineer arbejder du tæt sammen med udviklere, product management, designere og forretningen.

Du får ansvar og medbestemmelse fra dag ét og bliver en del af et miljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at komme i mål. Vi forventer ikke, at du har svar på alt, men vi håber, at du er nysgerrig, stiller spørgsmål og bidrager til teamets udvikling.

Vi arbejder blandt andet med .NET/C#, API'er og cloud-løsninger på AWS og er i gang med at modernisere vores systemlandskab mod en mere serviceorienteret arkitektur.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

* udvikle og videreudvikle backend-services og API'er.
* arbejde med integrationer, databaser og forretningskritiske dataflows.
* bidrage til tekniske beslutninger og løbende forbedringer.
* tage ansvar for opgaver fra analyse og udvikling til test, release og drift.
* samarbejde tæt med udviklere, product management og forretningen.
* anvende AI-værktøjer og moderne udviklingsmetoder i hverdagen.

### **Teamet**

Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt team med software engineers, designere, product management og tæt kontakt til forretningen.

Vi har stor tillid til hinanden og lægger vægt på, at det skal være både fagligt spændende og rart at gå på arbejde. Det er helt almindeligt at bede om hjælp, sparre om løsninger og dele idéer undervejs.

Vi tager vores arbejde seriøst, men ikke os selv alt for højtideligt. Derfor håber vi også, at du bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og har lyst til at dele viden, skabe energi og hjælpe med at gøre teamet til et sted, hvor folk ser frem til at møde ind.

Uanset om du motiveres af kode, teknologi, domæneforståelse eller samarbejde med mennesker, får du mulighed for at udvikle dig og bidrage til løsningerne.

Det primære arbejdssted er Teglholmen i København.

### **Din profil**

Du har nogle års erfaring som software engineer og er klar til at tage ansvar for både løsninger og samarbejde.

Du behøver ikke at have prøvet det hele før. Det vigtigste er, at du er dygtig til dit håndværk, har lyst til at lære nyt og motiveres af at skabe værdi sammen med andre.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

* har erfaring med backend-udvikling i .NET/C#.
* har arbejdet med API'er, integrationer og databaser.
* har erfaring med moderne softwareudvikling og god kodekvalitet.
* har arbejdet med cloud-platforme/AWS.
* arbejder struktureret med Git, test og samarbejde omkring kode.
* er nysgerrig på nye teknologier og AI-understøttet softwareudvikling.

Vi forestiller os, at du også har erfaring med:

* JavaScript eller TypeScript.
* React eller andre moderne frontend-frameworks.
* messaging og eventbaserede arkitekturer.
* GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes og Terraform.
* Power Platform, Dynamics og Umbraco.

### **Hvem håber vi, du er?**

Du er typen, der:

* får tingene til at ske uden at skulle have alting perfekt på forhånd.
* er nysgerrig og har lyst til hele tiden at lære nyt.
* hjælper andre og selv beder om hjælp, når det giver mening.
* bidrager til et godt samarbejde omkring dig.
* kan lide at samarbejde med mennesker, der tænker anderledes end dig selv.
* synes, at det er sjovere at vinde som hold end alene.

Vi søger en kollega, som har lyst til at være en del af et fagligt dygtigt team, bidrage med sine kompetencer og gøre hverdagen bedre for de mennesker, man arbejder sammen med.

### **TV 2 som teknologiarbejdsplads**

I TV 2s teknologiorganisation arbejder over 320 specialister hver dag med at udvikle hele den teknologiske værdikæde – fra avanceret medieteknologi og liveproduktion til digitale produkter som apps, streamingtjenester, dataløsninger og brugeroplevelser. Det er her, vi omsætter målet om personlig public service til konkrete løsninger, som møder danskernes behov på tværs af platforme.

Vi arbejder i tværfaglige teams – med bl.a. Software Engineers, UX‑designere, Enterprise Architects, konfigurationsspecialister og Data Scientists – og vi har fokus på kvalitet, tilgængelighed, performance og sikkerhed i alt, hvad vi bygger og driver. Du får kolleger i både Odense på Kvægtorvet og i København på Teglholmen samt en kultur, hvor læring, videndeling og ansvar går hånd i hånd med dynamikken i Danmarks største mediehus.

### **Søg stillingen**

Du sender dit CV og en kort motivation via formularen nedenfor. Ansøgningsfrist er d.12.oktober, hvorefter vi inviterer til samtaler.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Backend Developer, Partner Integrations
jobs.description:
**Are you a backend developer who enjoys building reliable integrations and delivering scalable solutions? Are you motivated by taking ownership of your projects from development to deployment?**

Then you could be the one we are looking for to help build the integrations that connect JACK & JONES, VERO MODA and ONLY with leading marketplaces such as Amazon and Zalando! We offer the opportunity to work in a quality-driven environment with plenty of opportunities for professional development and technical challenges.

**THE DEPARTMENT**  
Brand Tech is a dynamic e-commerce department with the ambition of making our brands the preferred fashion choice across both our own webshops and external marketplaces. You will join an in-house team of experienced frontend and backend developers working closely together to deliver robust digital solutions across brands.  
You will become part of an international environment where collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are central to the way we work.

**THE JOB**  
As part of the Partner Team, you will develop and maintain the backend connectors that integrate our brands with marketplaces such as Amazon, Zalando and other partners. Your focus will be on building reliable, scalable integrations that ensure accurate and efficient data exchange.  
Working in a data-driven environment, you will help ensure that product information, stock levels and pricing flow seamlessly between our internal systems and external marketplace platforms.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Developing and maintaining APIs and marketplace connectors
* Ensuring stable synchronisation of product data, stock and pricing
* Onboarding new marketplace partners
* Optimising integrations and data flows across systems
* Taking ownership of projects from implementation to deployment.

**YOUR PROFILE**  
You're motivated by solving technical challenges and enjoy building reliable, scalable solutions. You're curious by nature, enjoy learning new technologies and value collaboration and knowledge sharing. You like working closely with your teammates and seeing your work through from development to deployment.

We care more about your curiosity, technical skills and genuine interest in software development than ticking every box. What matters most is that you:

* Have experience with .NET / C#
* Have experience working with XML and JSON
* Communicate well and enjoy collaborating across teams
* Speak and write English fluently

Experience with one or more of the following is an advantage:

Marketplace or e-commerce APIs (e.g. Amazon SP-API, Zalando Partner Program (zDirect), Tradebyte or Channable)

* Kubernetes
* Jira, GitHub and GitHub Actions
* Unit and integration testing
* Google Cloud Platform or other cloud providers
* Datadog
* Microservice architecture
* Event-driven integrations and message queues (e.g. Google Pub/Sub or Amazon SQS).

**WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU**  
**I**f you have any questions regarding the position, feel free to contact Rasmus Skjoldborg Jørgensen +45 82 38 21 56. Otherwise, please send your application and CV along with relevant examples of your skills and previous projects no later than 30 October 2026.

**WORKPLACE:** Brande Denmark.

**ABOUT BESTSELLER**  
*At BESTSELLER, we are more than 20,000 people in 38 different countries working for over 20 fashion brands such as JACK & JONES, SELECTED, VERO MODA, ONLY, PIECES, VILA, OBJECT, MAMALICIOUS, NAME IT, NOISY MAY and Y.A.S. We are a family-owned company with a strong foundation and values to build on, empowering us to pursue the ideas we believe in to take BESTSELLER forward. We are committed to diversity and provide equal opportunities for everyone, irrespective of sex, race, ethnicity, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. We strive to create an empowering environment where people can thrive and develop. For more information, visit www.bestseller.com.*
